target.title: fix(agent): check updateSessionEntry return value for pendingFinalDelivery write
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where `pendingFinalDelivery` state written via `updateSessionEntry` silently discards write failures. If the store write fails (IO error, disk full, permission denied), the delivery state is lost and restart recovery reads stale state — the reply is never re-sent.

## Why This Change Was Made

Added `requireWriteSuccess: true` to the `updateSessionEntry` options for the `pendingFinalDelivery` write. This is a durable state write where silent failure would cause data loss. The `requireWriteSuccess` option makes the store throw on write failure instead of silently recovering, so the caller (`runReplyAgent`) properly fails when this critical metadata cannot be persisted. This is the same pattern used in 4 other call sites for critical state writes: `dashboard-session-title.ts:109`, `session-lifecycle-state.ts:285`, `main-session-restart-recovery.ts:217`, `state-migrations.ts:5693`.

## User Impact

None in normal operation. On store write failure, the agent run now throws instead of silently losing pending delivery state.

## Evidence

- **Real environment tested**: Linux, Node 22, branch `fix/check-pending-delivery-write`
- **Detailed failure-injection proof** (`pending-final-delivery.store-write-failure.test.ts`): Injects an ENOENT write failure at the `writeTextAtomic` layer (the underlying atomic file-write function) and verifies that `updateSessionEntry` with `requireWriteSuccess: true` propagates the error instead of silently swallowing it.

  ```console
  $ pnpm exec vitest run src/auto-reply/reply/pending-final-delivery.store-write-failure.test.ts --config test/vitest/vitest.auto-reply.config.ts --reporter=verbose

   ✓ |auto-reply| pending-final-delivery.store-write-failure.test.ts >
       pendingFinalDelivery requireWriteSuccess >
       propagates store write failure WITH requireWriteSuccess:true (PR #102128)

   Test Files  1 passed (1)
        Tests  1 passed (1)
  ```

  The test:
  1. Creates a real session store on disk with an existing entry
  2. Injects an ENOENT write failure at the atomic write layer (`writeTextAtomic`)
  3. Calls `updateSessionEntry` with the same arguments as the `pendingFinalDelivery` write path — crucially with `requireWriteSuccess: true`
  4. Asserts the promise rejects with the injected error — proving the write failure is no longer silently discarded

- **Store contract proof**: The `requireWriteSuccess` flag controls ENOENT behavior at two distinct store paths:
  - **Windows retry loop** (`store.ts:944-948`): Without the flag, ENOENT on the first retry is silently swallowed; with it, the error is thrown.
  - **Non-Windows full write path** (`store.ts:994-999`): Without the flag, repeated ENOENT is silently recovered; with it, the error is thrown.
  - The hot single-entry persistence path passes `requireWriteSuccess` through to these code paths and also propagates write failures directly.

- **Existing tests**:

  ```console
  $ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/auto-reply/reply/pending-final-delivery.test.ts
  Test Files  1 passed (1)
       Tests  4 passed (4)
  ```

## Regression Test Plan

```console
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/auto-reply/reply/pending-final-delivery.test.ts
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/auto-reply/reply/pending-final-delivery.store-write-failure.test.ts
```

---

AI-assisted.
